text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaah! Good work. You ran well today too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My stomach is empty too. Yeah, like this, 
I think I can finish all of those 
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Didn't I mention it? The other day, 
by the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no way! This truck's loaded with 
this much veggies, you know? There's no 
way it'll come out of the ditch so easily—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Easy peasy. Just keep your foot on the 
gas, pops.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, make sure you're ready to hit the 
brakes, okay? Here we go! ...Ready, and!"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah!! Hit the, the braaaakes!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And then they said, 'Take all these 
veggies, young lady!' and let me have them 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I handed them out to everyone, but there 
was quite a lot, so I couldn't get through 
it all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! I think I'll just make 
hot pot at home and gobble it all up by 
myself♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Along with a heaping mountain of meat and 
white rice!
choice_data_list: How about cooking it and storing it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Along with a heaping mountain of meat and 
white rice!
choice_data_list: How about cooking it and storing it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! You mean meal prepping, right? Yeah, 
yeah, that's a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not really skilled enough to 
handle such detailed work, you know~

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah. How about we just dump everything in 
the oil? That way it'll cook through, and 
it sounds easy and fun!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh! There are this many ways to cook 
vegetables? Looks like they'll keep for a 
while too—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
~♪ What a lovely scent. I'm so glad I 
asked for your help!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, this one's already done, right? 
Can I have a little taste?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mm, delicious♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mr. C.B. slowly and deliciously 
worked her way through the mountain of 
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Except... there's just one little 
problem, you see?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mm, delicious! I've thought this for a 
while, but you're a really good cook.
choice_data_list:
I just chopped up the ingredients and put 
them in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she isn't great at cooking, I 
visited her place, made a massive hot pot, 
and shared a meal with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The carrot dango turned out especially 
well, and just as I reached my chopsticks 
out for the last one remaining—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I want to eat! If possible, I'd love 
to eat even more... can you make some 
more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mr. C.B. deliciously polished off 
the massive pile of ingredients.
